library(ggplot2)

months <- c(
  "Oct '23","Nov '23","Dec '23","Jan '24","Feb '24","Mar '24",
  "Apr '24","May '24","Jun '24","Jul '24","Aug '24","Sep '24",
  "Oct '24","Nov '24","Dec '24","Jan '25","Feb '25","Mar '25",
  "Apr '25","May '25"
)

level_map <- c("Rubble" = 1, "Camp" = 2, "Suburban" = 3, "Urban" = 4)

color_map <- c(
  "Rubble"   = "#D06A5C",
  "Camp"     = "#E0C04C",
  "Suburban" = "#7FA9D8",
  "Urban"    = "#78B88B"
)

make_timeline_plot <- function(location_name, values, out_file) {

  df <- data.frame(
    month  = factor(months, levels = months),
    level  = factor(values, levels = c("Rubble","Camp","Suburban","Urban")),
    height = unname(level_map[values])
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = month, y = height, fill = level)) +
    geom_col(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      width = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(1,2,3,4),
      labels = c("Rubble","Camp","Suburban","Urban"),
      limits = c(0,4.2),
      expand = c(0,0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(location_name, ": Infrastructure Level Timeline\nOctober 2023 to May 2025"),
      x = "Month",
      y = "Infrastructure Level"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.line   = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks  = element_line(color = "black"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = out_file,
    plot     = p,
    width    = 10,
    height   = 5,
    dpi      = 300,
    bg       = "white"
  )
}

gaza_city_values <- c(
  "Urban","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble",
  "Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble",
  "Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble"
)

khan_younis_values <- c(
  "Urban","Urban","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble",
  "Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble",
  "Rubble","Rubble","Rubble","Rubble"
)

make_timeline_plot("Gaza City", gaza_city_values, "gaza_city_infrastructure_level.png")
make_timeline_plot("Khan Younis", khan_younis_values, "khan_younis_infrastructure_level.png")
